rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=200, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=10, tv_step_init=0.0001, tv_lambda_init=0.001, tv_share_steps=False, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-2 (breast_ct). DIAGNOSIS of iter-1 (step_init=1e-2): hr=0.0, val_psnr=17.27 dB -- 19 dB WORSE than the LD-FBP baseline (36.32 dB), val_ssim 0.719 vs baseline 0.920. SLURM training log (job 772163) is the smoking gun: loss FROZEN at 0.004813 across ALL 10 epochs and every learned step[k]=0.01 / lambda[k]=0.001 PINNED at init (only step_9 drifted to 0.00937). FAILURE MODE (named): STEP-TOO-LARGE OVERSHOOT -> saturated-gradient training freeze. Mechanism (docs/findings.md 2026-05-23 + Mayo iter-3): the data gradient R^T(R f - g) uses the RAW unnormalized adjoint of the 128-view breast forward op; tv_step_init=0.01 (inherited from the classical sibling's tv_lr) is ~operator-norm too large, so f - 0.01*R^T(...) overshoots into a bad clamped basin at K=1, the clamp/divergence kills the gradient to the 20 log-scalars -> they never move -> recon diverges from FBP regardless of epochs. baseline FBP PSNR=36.32 confirms data/projector are fine; only the unrolled step scale is wrong. ONE KNOB: tv_step_init 1e-2 -> 1e-4 (100x smaller; keeps the unrolled iteration INSIDE the stable basin near FBP where gradients flow to the scalars). Historical breast iter-2 (findings 2026-05-23) used exactly step_init=1e-4 and the recon stayed near FBP (loss dropped, scalars departed init). All else IDENTICAL to iter-1 (K=10, train_n=400, epochs=10, bs=1, lambda_init=1e-3, lr=5e-3, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0). HYPOTHESIS: at 100x smaller step the training UN-FREEZES -- loss DECREASES across epochs, step[k]/lambda[k] DEPART from init, and val_psnr recovers from 17.3 toward/above the FBP floor (36.3 dB) so hr rises above 0. FALSIFIER: if loss stays flat AND scalars stay pinned, the harness is deeper-broken (then iter-3 attacks init: drop FBP-init / zero-init, or deepen K). BUDGET: iter-1 ran 750s total (<1200s wall); identical compute -> ~750s.
